newsitem.title: USA: U.S. COPPER ROD OUTPUT UP 4.4 PCT ON YEAR - ABMS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. COPPER ROD OUTPUT UP 4.4 PCT ON YEAR - ABMS.

text.p: U.S. copper rod production totaled 2,221,780,000 lbs in the first half of the year, up 4.4 percent from last year's corresponding period, which totaled 2,127,847,000 lbs, according to the American Bureau of Metal Statistics.
June production totaled 360,131,000 lbs, down 3.9 percent from May, which totaled 374,737,000 lbs, but up 1.90 percent from June 1996, which totaled 353,401,000 lbs.
Rod shipments in the first half of the year totaled 2,389,627,000 lbs, up 7.6 percent from last year's first half, which totaled 2,221,083,000 lbs.
June shipments totaled 375,360,000 lbs, down 5.4 percent from May, which totaled 396,890,000 lbs, but up 5.3 percent from June 1996, which totaled 356,353,000 lbs.
Inventories as of June 30 totaled 120,290,000 lbs, down 9.5 percent from May 31, which totaled 132,920,000 lbs, and down 12.7 percent from June 1996, which totaled 137,761,000 lbs.
